visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black t-shirt and a navy blue baseball cap stands in a modern, well-lit kitchen. On the white countertop in front of him are several gleaming stainless steel pans and a large product box labeled 'UCOM'. He holds a manual and gestures toward the cookware while speaking. (2) The scene shifts to the man standing by a gas stove where a large wok is placed. He maintains a skeptical expression, looking directly at the camera. The kitchen background features light-colored cabinetry and a range hood. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the interior of the stainless steel wok. The man pours a small amount of water into the hot pan, which beads up and dances across the surface. He then pours a thin stream of cooking oil from a glass bottle into the center. (4) The man cracks an egg into the hot, oiled wok. The egg whites immediately begin to turn opaque and sizzle. The camera remains in a close-up, capturing the details of the egg's texture and the reflective surface of the metal pan. (5) Using a metal spatula, the man gently nudges the fried egg. It slides effortlessly across the pan's surface without sticking. He then tosses the pan, flipping the egg perfectly into the air and catching it. He looks surprised and impressed. (6) The man switches to a shallower frying pan on the same stove. He places a piece of raw fish fillet into the pan alongside some sliced ginger. The fish sizzles as it makes contact with the hot surface. He shakes the pan to demonstrate that the fish is not sticking. (7) Finally, the man stir-fries slices of beef in the large wok. He uses the spatula to move the meat rapidly, showing that even with high heat and fast movement, the food remains loose and does not adhere to the stainless steel.

(18) [Subtitle]: 沒有在唬爛的喔 你看翻得過...喔. (19) [Subtitle]: (換用平底鍋煎魚試試看）. (20) [Subtitle]: 哎喲 真的不沾哎. (21) [Subtitle]: 快炒也沒問題喔. (22) [Subtitle]: (好，可以開團）.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern residential kitchen with white countertops, light grey or beige cabinets, a stainless steel range hood, and various kitchen appliances like a toaster and jars visible on the counters.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male speaker begins talking in an energetic, conversational tone over a rhythmic, upbeat electronic BGM with a strong percussive beat. His speech rate is moderately fast. (2) A sharp clinking sound occurs as he moves the manual. The BGM remains steady. He expresses skepticism with a slightly higher pitch and increased vocal intensity. (3) The sound of rushing water followed by a short hiss as it hits the hot metal pan marks the start of this phase. Then, a low-frequency glugging sound of oil being poured is heard. (4) A loud, sharp cracking sound of an eggshell followed by a sudden, intense sizzling sound (broadband noise) as the egg hits the hot oil. The speaker's voice is expectant. (5) Frequent metallic scraping and clinking sounds as the spatula interacts with the pan. The speaker lets out a loud 'Oh!' of surprise (high arousal), followed by a female voice also expressing excitement. (6) A heavy, loud sizzle occurs as fish is placed in the pan. The sound of a metal pan sliding on a metal grate is audible. The BGM maintains its tempo underneath. (7) Vigorous clinking of metal against metal accompanies the sound of quick stir-frying. The speaker's voice reaches a peak of excitement and satisfaction as the demonstration concludes.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Introduction -> Skeptical Setup -> Empirical Testing (Leidenfrost/Egg/Fish/Beef) -> Validated Result -> Conclusion/Recommendation.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate the high-quality non-stick performance of Kuhn Rikon (UCOM) stainless steel cookware through real-world stress tests. The creator uses his initial skepticism as a hook to build trust, ultimately proving the product's effectiveness to encourage viewers to participate in a group purchase.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video starts by explicitly mentioning an invitation from the brand UCOM and concludes with a mention of opening a group buy (開團).

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes the 'Leidenfrost effect' (water droplets dancing on the pan) as visual evidence of correct heat management for stainless steel, which is a key educational point for potential customers.
